comment: The class of each tool of fsm that is checked by make rebuild-check (S1); kit finds the tool sources by the layout of the repository and this file classifies them. A tool of an ecosystem that fsm uses as it is is not listed here.

packages/gui/scripts/make-favicon.mjs.reason: a one-time generator of the 16x16 icon public/favicon.ico, which is committed; no build or CI step runs it, and an ecosystem image tool would be a dependency for one fixed icon

scripts/check-name.mts.reason: the check of one rule of this repository, that no tracked file names the library by its old name outside the reasoned entries; no ecosystem tool states that rule

scripts/check-readmes.mts.reason: the check of the required sections and the Korean twin of each README pair of this repository, which no ecosystem tool states
